options.item: Kobus intercity express bus, Busan to Seoul
options.details: Direct express service, about 4h15m, multiple daily departures from Busan Central Bus Terminal to Seoul Express Bus Terminal

options.item: KTX high-speed train, Busan to Seoul
options.details: Non-stop KTX service, about 2h35m, reserved economy seating, Busan Station to Seoul Station

options.item: KTX First Class, Busan to Seoul, with door-to-door car transfers
options.details: KTX First Class carriage, about 2h35m, plus a chauffeured car transfer to Busan Station and from Seoul Station, roughly 3h15m total door-to-door

Low Activity.details: Large, air-conditioned collection halls with ample seating; a sit-and-stroll pace throughout
Cluster of traditional tea houses within a couple of blocks of each other; minimal walking if you pick adjoining stops

Medium Activity.item: Gyeongbokgung Palace and Bukchon Hanok Village walk
Medium Activity.details: Palace grounds plus a roughly 0.8 mile stroll through the hanok alleys, even paving throughout
About 1h15m from Seoul by shuttle and ferry; flat, tree-lined paths around the island, under a mile for the main loop

High Activity.item: Bukhansan National Park, Baegundae Peak trail
High Activity.details: Hilly granite-peak trail, over a mile one-way to the summit, rated strenuous
About 1h from Seoul; includes an uneven, hilly walking tour of the Third Tunnel and observation post
